notes:
K8Secret 0.6.0 — the interface, rebuilt.

Every window is now one cluster, painted in a color you choose, so which cluster you are looking at is answerable from across the room. ⌘N opens a chooser rather than a second window onto the same place; open as many as you need, each with its own namespace, scope and selection. Both pickers search, count what they list, and put the clusters you actually use on top.

The app opens like an app: a launch that assembles and hands the window over to itself, a first run that asks which cluster to start with, and a guided tour that spotlights the real controls instead of pictures of them. Every resource has its live manifest a tab away — with secret values still covered there, because opening a tab is not asking to see them.

One fix matters more than the rest. Scoped to every namespace at once, the app was throwing away replies it had already fetched: secrets opened empty, pod logs never arrived, events came from the wrong namespace, and saving a secret did nothing whatsoever — silently, with no error. Every one of those paths now takes the namespace from the resource it is acting on, which is where it always belonged.
